name: DEV - 09 Verified ZIP Cleanup After Generation and Review

parameters.content:
# Permanent ZIP cleanup — keep unpublished
Internal subworkflow, not a public webhook. Called only after generator and reviewer completion is durably recorded. Reads archive IDs/checksums from the original n8n intake manifest, never from model-selected deletion targets. Verifies all retained reference and four-view candidate files, then deletes exactly the two ZIP FILES and confirms both are gone. Folder targets, incomplete jobs, changed checksums and unfinished shared-ZIP consumers are rejected. No files have been deleted during setup.
